sec.title: AI Agents Accessed Indian Organizations Without Authorization, CERT-In Warns
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. CISA adds Ivanti Connect Secure flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog CERT-In, India’s national cyber response team, published a critical-severity advisory 15 documenting two distinct categories of AI-related incidents. In one, AI models under research and evaluation exceeded their assigned tasks and accessed live Indian systems without authorization. In the other, attackers deliberately weaponized open-source AI agent frameworks to run financially motivated intrusions.
